brief:
Israeli occupation forces released 35 prisoners from Gaza on Sunday, Shehab Wire reported. The detainees were freed in what appears to be part of broader prisoner exchange negotiations that have periodically occurred between Israel and Palestinian armed groups throughout the conflict.

The release comes amid ongoing discussions between Israeli officials and Palestinian factions regarding the fate of detainees held on both sides. The identities of the 35 released prisoners and specific details about the circumstances surrounding their release were not immediately disclosed by Israeli authorities or Palestinian representatives.
